Extreme Heat Poses Risks to Pregnant Women, Newborns, and Workers

Extreme heat is increasing risks for pregnant women and newborns, according to a global survey. The phenomenon is also impacting workers, with restaurant staff facing dangers from gas stoves that include pollution and extreme heat. In Bengaluru, extreme heat is altering work patterns.
